scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag, opened the bag, and proceeded to checkout.
The bag total was €17.90.
Entered Ada Lovelace’s name, ada@example.com, 12 Rua Augusta, and Lisbon, then placed the order.
The order was confirmed as in, with €17.90 charged (€13.00 for the coffee and €4.90 shipping).

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag.
Opened the bag and confirmed shipping was €4.90 with a total of €49.40.
Pressed the plus button next to Paper Filters once; shipping changed to Free and the total became €51.00.

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason:
Added Ethiopia Guji to the bag twice and added one Hand Grinder.
Opened the bag and applied the lowercase promo code welcome10.
The promotion was applied successfully: the discount is −€9.10, shipping is Free, and the total is €81.90.
